subject: SPEC: chart label opacity fixes + std-bar aria-label
body: FIX 1: SVG chart opacity (buildChart). x-axis fill rgba 0.35->0.55. Legend color rgba 0.5->0.65. C line 0.10->0.20, C label 0.28->0.42. B line 0.14->0.25, B label 0.35->0.55 (text-anchor middle only). FIX 2: std-bar progressbar - add aria-label=id+pct. Reason: T1 audit found B/C labels fail AA at 10px. T9 found progress bars missing dimension label.
